name: finledger
description: FinLedger — Production-grade Expense Splitting, Invoicing & Personal Finance Platform (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "cross-env USE_MEMORY_DB=true npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
